name: Can an interior reconfiguration improve home accessibility and aging-in-place?

mainEntity.name: Can an interior reconfiguration improve home accessibility and aging-in-place?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, accessibility is one of the most effective reasons to redesign an interior layout. Typical modifications include widening narrow doorways to accommodate mobility devices, eliminating threshold steps, expanding hallway clearances, and removing interior partition walls to create curbless, barrier-free bathroom layouts. HH Remodeling provides specialized accessibility modifications, reframing doorways and repositioning fixtures to improve everyday movement and safety while maintaining an attractive, seamless finish throughout the home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, reconfiguring layouts can widen doorways, remove awkward room transitions, and expand bathroom footprints to accommodate mobility equipment comfortably.
